notes.title: UPDATE v1.2
notes.content:
Hi! 

First, we would like to thank you for being part of this amazing community! We are excited to announce that Update 1.2 is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/988728c03514bf29470da026caaa63cf4f7aa052.png[/img]
To summarize, this is the 12th update since the game's release. Over the course of these updates, we’ve improved and fixed more than 150 issues! The game is now better optimized, more balanced, has fixed bugs, and features new additions. We invite you to start your adventure in the world of Moon Mystery alongside Toby!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/cd2e603bce01225de6eddbf81db363398e3f13c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/7921eb84347465fd18b3312824aa8019786f6164.png[/img]
You can now play using a gamepad! While this is partial controller support, as the game was originally designed for mouse and keyboard and is best played with them, the entire game is still fully playable from start to finish with a controller. Remember, you can enable or disable aim assist for controllers in the settings at any time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/c68fc8edc0ca3d82e46f966c866b00d34727f954.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/3714ba66344d23f7a2047c064ed6c7a66d575aaa.png[/img]
Based on your feedback and extensive playtesting, we’ve made many small tweaks to the game, including adjustments to:
[olist]
[*] Ammunition
[*] Damage (for both players and enemies)
[*] Health (for both players and enemies)
[*] Stamina
[/olist]
These minor improvements across the board have enhanced the overall experience, making the game feel more balanced and enjoyable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/b954884d437a18fd02917ec9801d7183d37b7a79.png[/img]
We did another fix for attachments. Some achievements, which were particularly tricky to address as they affected only a very small number of players, have been temporarily hidden to ensure that everyone can fully enjoy unlocking achievements. Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/b2e9251cf80077e23e51744c0f00e3e31fe7b165.png[/img]

We’ve also made numerous improvements to the game’s translations. Lines that were previously untranslated are now fully translated, and we’ve refined existing translations to make them sound more natural and polished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/3878e9f63fc307ab001c4a14d8efe15944bfa460.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash on the submarine level (additional patch applied).

[*] Resolved an issue where objects couldn't be picked up with the scanner equipped.

[*] Fixed a strange behavior when pausing the game during anomalies while driving the sedan.

[*] Corrected human banners appearing in the background of the robot city.

[*] Addressed a visual bug in the underwater base when controlling a missile.

[*] Fixed life bar not decreasing initially when shooting the machine gun turret.

[*] Removed an unfairly placed drone on the ice planet near the sliding big ice rock.

[*] Fixed an invisible wall on the ice planet.

[*] Enlarged the final door in the last ice planet puzzle to fit properly.

[*] Fixed incorrect icons for gamepad graphics in settings; RS and LS were swapped.

[*] Resolved a bad single frame appearing in the final cutscene.

[*] Fixed the "Save after destroying pillar" bug where the laser puzzle save prevented the arena door from 
opening.

[*] Fixed a floating cosmonaut costume when jumping into a wormhole.

[*] Fixed a bug where the reset vehicle button displayed incorrectly as "B" instead of "R" on the keyboard.

[*] Updated tutorials for switching vehicle cameras using a gamepad.

[*] Improved default sensitivity settings for gamepad controls.

[*] Adjusted sensitivity on the gamepad to ensure better responsiveness.

[*] Updated all in-game prompts to display the appropriate gamepad button icons (e.g., "Press X to interact" instead of "Press F").

[*] Improved visual feedback for quick saves; the yellow line no longer appears on the sedan vehicle.

[*] Reduced difficulty on the alien landscape by removing one sniper robot from the train section.

[*] Fixed the weapon printer animation on the UFO base.

[*] Optimized the rendering of the Black Star 2 base to avoid visible loading when destroying distant 
pillars.

[*] Removed placeholder cube from the alien landscape.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/f88114748ba91fba2a180cb936791aa3aa968c04.png[/img]
[h3][b]If you have been playing Moon Mystery, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews make a huge difference for indie games like ours.[/b][/h3]

Thank you so much!

Mikolaj

notes.title: Update v1.11
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1]

Next update is live! 
[h3][b]Please let us know what else would you like us to fix/implement to make the experience better. [/b][/h3]

Thank you so much for all your feedback so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/317c9546dabf38e22db49ccd736322636c503ef4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added toggle sprint option

[*] Reduced game file size

[*] Fixed an issue where achievements might not unlock for some players. They should now work for everyone.

[*] Reduced default sensitivity when controlling the spaceship with a gamepad.

[*] Pressing "ESC" when you are in the menu is now returning to the previous screen.

[*] The scanner icon is not visible from the start of the game anymore.

[*] Added a vehicle reset point in Blue Desert to prevent getting stuck when resetting vehicles.

[*] Fixed an issue where Elite enemy rockets passed through objects. They now explode on obstacles.

[*] Fixed the interaction on UFO Base when collecting blue material. The prompt now shows "A" instead of "X" to avoid disabling RC Car controls.

[*] Fixed the objective indicator remaining visible after destroying the pillar in the boss arena.

[*] Fixed weapons disappearing after switching and progressing through save points.

[*] Fixed weapons vanishing when unlocking two at once.

[*] Fixed broken shooting after exiting vehicles or finishing cutscene interactions.

[*] Fixed an issue where the redfield wouldn’t disappear after defeating all enemies in Space level.

[*] Fixed weapons appearing outside the buggy on Red Desert.

[*] Enemy health bars (e.g., for spider explosives, machine gun turrets, and flying turrets) are now hidden when the "hide enemy health bars" option is enabled.

[*] Increased thrown grenade damage by 30%.

[*] Fixed invert Y for first person and vehicles not saving correctly between sessions.

[*] Fixed invert Y for vehicles not affecting torpedoes and missiles, improving usability in underwater interiors and the Blue Desert drone section.

[*] In the submarine and spaceship, shooting with a gamepad now uses “RB” instead of “A,” allowing players to aim and shoot simultaneously.

[*] Added a cutscene of jumping into the wormhole at the end of the space level.

[*] Fixed an issue where pressing escape near the end of the moon base could cause the camera to move to another place.

[*] Pressing “ESC” in the Loadout screen now resumes the game instead of returning to an earlier screen.

[*] Fixed flashlight keybindings for gamepad controls.

[*] Fixed an issue where achievements were not unlocking.

[*] Fixed an issue where the player could press escape to skip the tutorial about selecting the first skill.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/f88114748ba91fba2a180cb936791aa3aa968c04.png[/img]

[h3][b]If you have been playing Moon Mystery, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews make a huge difference for indie games like ours.[/b][/h3]

Thank you so much!

Mikolaj

[*] Fixed a problem when switching between game screens and another app, which caused issues with the cursor in the game.

Thank you for you support! 

[b]
UPDATE[/b]

[*] Resolved an issue where the reassigned Shift key was not working for some players.

notes.title: Day One Hotfix
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has jumped into Moon Mystery today! Your support on day one has meant so much to us, and your feedback has been amazing.  

We are actively reading reviews, bug reports, and player feedback.  We have pushed a day-one hotfix to address some of the feedback we have been given. We wanted to make sure we addressed these quickly for players. Here is the day one hotfix details:  

[olist]
[*] Some players reported the game was blurry. We believe we have applied a fix. [i]We want to hear your feedback if it worked! *[/i]
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Players reported that the skill wheel didn't work on Red Desert. [i]We have applied a fix where this should no longer be an issue [/i].
[*] You can now go into the menu while steering the missile. 
[*]We made a small tweak with explosive sniper, this change should now make it so that it doesn't get stuck. 
[/olist]

* Some players noted that the game was blurry for them. We have not been able to replicate this issue on our own hardware and we need your help with identifying the cause, and if our fix worked! 
We fixed a file on the backend where we had the resolution set to 87% instead of 100%. If this doesn't seem to work, we may remove FSR from options in another hotfix. We would love for you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/WxfvZRBbFC]Discord[/url] and let us know. Did our fix work, or are you experiencing the issue still? 

If you have been playing Moon Mystery, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews make a huge difference for indie games like ours, and we love to hear your thoughts and experiences. 

Thank you so much!
Cosmoscouts Team

notes.title: FLY INTO A BLACK HOLE TODAY! MOON MYSTERY IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
🎉 [b]Moon Mystery is officially released![/b]
What started as a hobby project after work has now grown into a full game launch by our small indie studio. Thank you so much to our incredible community – without your support, this release wouldn’t have been possible. We’re beyond grateful for everything you've done to help make this dream a reality!

[previewyoutube=P-w1XzWQs9E;full][/previewyoutube]

Want to experience one of the most thrilling black hole dives in gaming? You have to try Moon Mystery! Find out what awaits you inside this cosmic phenomenon.

🌐 [b]Explore Diverse Places[/b]
Love variety? Moon Mystery takes you across a range of unique locations, including the Moon, icy planets, desert planets, rocky worlds, and even our own Earth!

🚗 [b]More Vehicles Than You Can Imagine[/b]
Moon rover, spaceship, submarine, buggy, RC car, regular sedan – sounds like a lot, right? You’ll get to drive each and every one of them in Moon Mystery!

notes.title: Moon Mystery is coming to Steam on Oct 28th!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Qwk6w0KR4Ak;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🌑 Our closest celestial neighbor...[/h3]
The moon is a place full of strange things. Moon Mystery is a first-person shooter adventure full of puzzles, action, set on strange new worlds. The gray rocks of the Moon are just the first step on a great journey. Fill up your oxygen tanks, top up your magazines, and get ready for a long trip. You won't be seeing Earth for a while.

[h3]❔ Mystery and Intrigue[/h3]
Humanity's return to the Moon was no easy feat, requiring state-of-the-art technologies and Artificial Intelligence. Piece together what happened to the previous mission on the Silver Globe alongside the sole survivor, the AI computer. Our first permanent lunar base being the origin point for where everything went wrong. What happened? What do you need to prepare yourself against? Just why did we go to the Moon in the first place?

[h3]🤖 Adapt, Improvise, Overcome.. and Survive[/h3]
While outsmarting puzzles and platforming through the environment is one thing… Dealing with malfunctioning robots stalking the corridors alongside other, more terrifying and mysterious foes, is another. Keep that gun loaded alongside oxygen bottles, you'll need it.

[h3]🌠 Wishlist the Game[/h3]
Follow our socials, join our Discord, and wishlist the game to countdown until the game’s release!

notes.title: Captain's Log: April
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're thrilled to share an exciting update about our game! We finish all the levels design and now we are focusing on polishing. Thanks to the revolutionary Wormhole system, we now have the ability to travel between various locations across the universe. Get ready to explore icy planets, scorching hot worlds, mysterious caves, and even the depths of the underwater realm. But that's not all – you'll also have the chance to journey back to Earth for some familiar gameplay!

This diverse array of environments is set to make your gaming experience truly engaging and dynamic. Depending on your level, you'll have the option to conquer these places on foot, in a vehicle (such as a buggy, car), spaceship, or even a submarine.

Get ready to embark on an epic adventure like never before!

notes.title: Captain's Log: May
notes.content:
Dear Earth friends:

We have discovered a new planet and wish to share a sneak peek with you.

This is a Red Desert Planet…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/5b9db53e7396b734157e894829175fc6be68cebf.png[/img]

…with a new arena and in that arena - a boss fight! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/3d7726da0b484194dcc569432296d2597044d0f7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/cd952df58d97731c8025154a48393a1662f28414.png[/img]

We’re currently also working on the energy pillar, which is going to be an important part of the gameplay loop. We are now experimenting with different versions of how it could work/look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/5d9d638a00059b59a06ce1a90f34fca90312ea04.png[/img]

After some brainstorming, we decided that it's going to work like a fusebox in one of the recent Far Crys games. There was a fusebox in Far Cry which you can destroy with an animated interaction BUT the fusebox had multiple animations of it being destroyed to be more interesting.

We also want to do it that way, so we needed to create a completely new model. The new model is going to be prepared for the animations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/0fbd45af33859f451a859b108c7b083476589e3f.png[/img]

The animations will be:
The player opens the main box, disables the fuses and then turn and activates the main switch (the big circular switch, with a handle, it has to be turned and then pulled)
The player opens the main box, furiously pulls off the cables going from the breakers and activates the main switch.
The player furiously rips off the pipe. Maybe some coolant or some sort of steam comes from it.

Let us know which sketch you like the best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/8395afb10b7640abf5704464816b6316b7211276.png[/img]

In other news, our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/moonmystery/moonmystery?ref=nav_search&result=project&term=moon%20mystery]Kickstarter is almost fully funded![/url] We’re currently at 93% - that’s so close to the goal! Don't forget to help us shove it in your friends faces I mean, POLITELY SHARE the Kickstarter and your excitement for the upcoming game to help us get Moon Mystery to the finish line.

As always, thank you everyone for your continued support. We couldn’t do it without you! Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Vh7VqAQJce]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/moonmysterygame]Twitter,[/url] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@moon_mystery_game]TikTok[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7arolztzLI3dbNC9F1kxkQ]YouTube[/url] for more Moon Mystery updates.

See you next time and fly high!
-The Cosmoscouts Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/3d31e8d5b052e1ca80cbc0b0d923e803432c42a9.png[/img]

The hallways leading to the unknown are always a great place to start! Look at the views outside the windows. (Space sure is dark, isn't it?)

This level will involve a little bit of this (puzzles) and a little bit of that (pew pew).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/44bdeff78b8806f4a031dfd757f962979ea9d076.png[/img]

Look at all these tablets in this room! Hopefully they’ll contain a clue.

Sun’s out, guns out! You’ll have a range of weapons to choose from while solving the mystery on the moon. Here’s a couple examples:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/10f2018e604202535488a8aca7deebb4717a38a2.png[/img]

Nothing to see here. Everything is definitely normal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/5a349096cf57d7cd81fdbb7865f5d547b1d7643e.png[/img]

Very much so normal here.

You’ll also meet robots and other beings while you explore in different locations. 
Such as this new friend in a storage room!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/9e96398188816d1f9a21219b374ac7e1dc988155.png[/img]

…at least, I hope he’s a friend. (He’s probably not, so let’s back away for now.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/456151dac47880af0c0bd1435574446fd1f02062.png[/img]

Remember to always be careful - they could be anywhere!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/2d7dfe1b7c30973b3fbd613ca596340e4e373ff3.png[/img]

Yes, even in your other storage rooms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/78fed29299083404acccda4aa0b61d5d0c3fecfb.png[/img]

And especially in your hallways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/83795314d4c6531d143999c4043abf326040bb60.png[/img]

Wow, all that exploring has made me exhausted. Just like our robotic friends who are, uh, napping on the floor. (Definitely napping.) I should probably take a nap and recharge too! But real quick, here's a sneak peak of the interaction animations we are working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/de33287d4a249bc1aa9ff43023baee368e59a62e.gif[/img]

As always, thank you everyone for your continued support. We couldn’t do it without you! Don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on Twitter and TikTok for more Moon Mystery updates.

[url=https://discord.gg/Vh7VqAQJce]Discord [/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/moonmysterygame]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@moon_mystery_game?]TikTok [/url]

Signing off,
Cosmoscouts

notes.title: Captain's Log - October
notes.content:
Dear Earth friends:

We have some really cool visual updates we’d love to share with you all today!

First of all, our wonderful artists have blessed us with some new illustrations. Let’s have a peek at these journal pages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/8d8c48f3e88aa88249dad8848210f47982bf30b4.png[/img]

While we’re immersed in exploration, we sometimes meet robots. Sometimes they’re friendly. Sometimes, they’re not. This is what one of the robots we meet looks like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/7d13cfd005523ed2ecbb9ee0b6f87ffe855bfd5d.png[/img]

Y’know when you really get the itch to create things but you just don’t have enough material? Well, this material is blue and you can use it to craft items for future use! Keep an eye out for these!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/417ba4d47837ee13975ad54b9329bb22203308af.png[/img]

One of the items in the game is a philar. This is what it looks like! You’ll have to wait to see what it’s used for in the game 😉 but we promise it’ll blow your mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/518e5ea9dfc79bc77bfd742bc6ea3bf0f540f7ee.png[/img]

Last but not least of our artist’s gifts to us this month, we have a drawing of a portal. You go in one end, and you come out on Earth - or vice versa. Super exciting!

In other news…
We’ve created a new level!

This new level is going to be in space, and there will be mostly platforming elements to give the game a different feel and playstyle. We can’t wait for you to explore and experience it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/f2a1c89571efb5a7e928bc7fed7f4df63f35b92d.png[/img]

As always, thank you everyone for your continued support. We couldn’t do it without you! Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Vh7VqAQJce]Discord [/url]and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/moonmysterygame]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@moon_mystery_game?]TikTok [/url]for more Moon Mystery updates.

Signing off, 
Cosmoscouts

notes.title: Captains Log - September
notes.content:
Dear Earth friends:

We have some really cool visual updates we’d love to share with you all today.

During your journey on the moon, you write letters to yourself in your diary. 
Here’s how this looked originally…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/a4f91d87e2222e7dfd320eb86417954e2679e2b9.png[/img]

…and now a look at what our great illustrator did with our letters! Inspired by Gone Home (the game), the astronaut will read the letters out loud when viewing. We can’t wait for you to hear all the letters read out loud!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/0d9cbd4b25fea05429cf20c1d6c9cdc25aaa8033.jpg[/img]

Walking isn't always the most fun mode of transporation, so we’ve also added a buggy to the game to help you get around.

Here’s a look at when it was first modeled and textured:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42093935/4d2134bb5e46180221be04ebb7dfcd16519d38b3.png[/img]

As always, thank you everyone for your continued support. We couldn’t do it without you! Don’t forget to join our [url=http://discord.gg/bbyAJaYztF]Discord [/url]and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/freedomgamesgg]Twitter [/url]for more Moon Mystery updates.

Signing off, 
Cosmoscouts

notes.title: Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that Moon Mystery is now being published by [url=https://freedom.gg]Freedom Games[/url]. For those of you who may not know, a game publisher can take care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. I was working on the game alone and right now we are a team of 6 people. It’s going to allow us to really focus on development while they take on more of the marketing side of things that will help the game be successful! Also we are right now displayed on Gamescom in the indie game booth arena. 

Game updates: 

- Redesigned all levels from scratch
- Better lighting, which means a better graphics
- We made main menu
- We are working on adding more weapons, so far we have 4 
- We added sliding and slow motion effect to make the gunplay more intense
- We have a great Sound Designer who is replacing every sound in the game
- We are working on another vehicle, sci-fi buggy
- We added a lot of conversations between you and the AI robot companion
- We are working on the the skill tree 

Thank you all for supporting us so far throughout development. Without all of your support, we may never have been able to get to this amazing milestone. With this extra support, we’re going to be working to get our dev updates more often for you all to get a little behind the scenes of what’s going on. If you have any specific questions or topics you want us to cover, please comment below this post! Otherwise, join our [url=https://discord.gg/Vh7VqAQJce]Discord [/url]and suggest it there!
